entities.summary: Keijō Shrine , sometimes Seoul Shrine, was a Shinto shrine in Keijō (Seoul), Korea, Empire of Japan. The shrine was established on November 3, 1898, and destroyed on November 17, 1945, several months after the end of colonial rule.
